messages:
Hannah W.: heads-up: Ruby onboarding sample with prefetch=4 + concurrency=6 produces repeating 429 waves. only seen on ruby-sdk image (2.0.1).
Diego P.: repro steps? command + logs?
Hannah W.: run: `RUBY_SDK=2.0.1 ./scripts/onboard.rb --concurrency 6 --prefetch 4 --mode embed_paginate` after ~45s it starts:
```2024-04-21T13:11:12Z WARN tokenbucket empty client_window=6 worker=3
2024-04-21T13:11:14Z ERROR request failed status=429 route=/v1/embeds detail=rate_limit_exceeded
2024-04-21T13:11:14Z WARN backpressure triggered workers=6
2024-04-21T13:11:17Z INFO refill tokens=6
```
Marta V.: ruby-sdk still uses a single mutex-protected refill loop AFAIK. if refill sleeps or auth refresh runs while locked, all workers block and then wake up and drain tokens in sync. that would explain the bursts.
Diego P.: interesting. JS and Py do per-worker refill jitter + per-page reservation in pagination. do we have parity docs for Ruby?
Hannah W.: not really. sample app was copied from older sample and didn't get the newer reservation logic. repro artifact pushed to `examples/ruby/onboard/throttle-waves` with scripts + logs.
Marta V.: immediate mitigation: reduce prefetch to 1 and add `refill_jitter_ms=rand(20..120)` in client. did quick patch locally and 20k rows ran without repeated 429 spikes.
Hannah W.: config patch:```client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'], concurrency:6, prefetch:1, refill_interval_ms:80, refill_jitter_ms:100)```
Diego P.: for a real fix we should: 1) implement per-worker token reservation so page requests reserve X tokens; 2) change refill to non-blocking (RCU-style pointer swap) and per-worker jitter; 3) handle server Retry-After per worker rather than a single global backoff value.
Marta V.: agree. also recommend adding a test in devex harness that runs ruby+python+js paginators concurrently to assert no >N 429s in any 10s window. i'll file the issue and draft the SDK PR.
Hannah W.: thanks. i'll add a short note to the onboarding readme suggesting safe defaults for ruby: "prefetch <=1, concurrency <=4, upgrade to ruby-sdk >=2.1.0 when available".
QA-bot: queued test: devex/integration/ruby-throttle-harness (build 5256) :white_check_mark:
Diego P.: also check auth rotation interactions — if refresh takes the refill lock we should make refresh async or avoid holding the refill mutex. ruby's `Mutex` around token state is probably the culprit.
Marta V.: good call. i'll make auth refresh background and update token pointer atomically. will include comprehensive unit tests and a cross-SDK compatibility test.
docs-bot: created PR draft: docs/onboarding/sdk-rate-limits.md -> draft  (link: https://git.redwood/devex/docs/pull/348)
Hannah W.: awesome. thanks team. leaving repro and quick patch in `examples/ruby/onboard/throttle-waves`. tagging @Marta V. and @Diego P. for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
